[USER] User wants to explore how to strike a balance between personal freedom and interdependence.

3. "Holding and Letting Go: The Social Practice of Personal Relationships" by Hilde Lindemann Nelson
4. "Love's Virtues: Literary and Philosophical Perspectives" edited by Tobias L. Winright
